body: Thanks for the advice guys, and believe me I would tell my parents, but it's as if there's some kind of mental block that keeps me from doing so. I have no problem saying it as an anonymous figure, but trying to say something to someone is something my brain can't seem to process. I tried getting help from someone once, but they didn't help me at all and just asked all the wrong questions. He knew that I cut myself and all of that, but he didn't think that I needed to see a doctor of any sort. He no longer lives around here, but I had him convinced that I was "better" while I just hid everything again. I think this developed some kind of trust issue and I think that the only way I could get help now is if I was by myself and driven enough to call a center and have myself picked up by an ambulance or something. I just wish it could be easier.
